name: DigitalCommunityShare
title: The ghost of DigitalCommunityShare
tagline: A friendly fixed-supply spirit from the Homestead era rests in silent, direct transfer.

chapters.heading: A ghost in the Homestead
paragraphs: A candle flickers near a name written in light. On May 13, 2016, the contract was born. It is a small program that lives on Ethereum. The wallet 0xd04f…98a3 brought it into the world.

It arrived during the Homestead era. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It was built with Solidity 0.2.0. Now it sits 10.5 years old as a fixed-supply token.

chapters.heading: The first shape of a token
paragraphs: The candle flickers over a name from a tutorial. It was born as DigitalCommunityShare with the symbol DCS. The supply was fixed at the moment of its birth. No one could ever create more units. It held its balances in a public mapping for all to see.

It moved wealth through a simple transfer. It checked for overflow and threw errors when funds were low. It had no owner and no way to give allowance to others. This was the before picture of what would become the ERC-20 standard.
The contract sat quiet after its busy days in 2017. It saw 648 transactions in its life. People called its transfer function to move the shares.

chapters.heading: The quiet of DigitalCommunityShare
paragraphs: The code still rests on the chain like a shadow. It has sat in the silence for 9.3 years. No one has called it since July 10, 2017.
The last call was a simple transfer. Now, it holds 0.0 ETH. It waits in the stillness with nothing left inside.
